systems.owner: Direction générale de la comptabilité publique et du Trésor (DGCPT)
systems.tiers: launched 2026-07-23 in Dakar; centralises and publishes the budgetary, accounting and financial data of the country's 601 collectivités territoriales; to be fed by public accountants and local authorising officers and interconnected with other state systems

systems.system: nouvelle application de recouvrement des taxes locales
systems.owner: Direction générale de la comptabilité publique et du Trésor (DGCPT)
systems.tiers: unnamed application for taxpayers' self-registration and payment of local taxes, already used in some communes of the Dakar region; official launch announced for the coming weeks or months

note: The Treasury's launch of a local-finance data platform; it gives the count of 601 collectivités territoriales but says nothing of their offices' connection or of staff entering data from the town hall.
